scope: one offline 512x512 embedded-texture prototype with explicit atlas filtering; no runtime integration or catalog admission

changeFromPreservedExperiment.change: Atlas sampler explicitly set to LinearFilter magnification, LinearMipmapLinearFilter minification, and generateMipmaps=true. Texture resolution, UVs, geometry, material color, and source inputs are unchanged.

output.sharp: 0.35.4 transitive build-time encoder; no dependency added

checks: Original full 4096x4096 TGA and corrected embedded 512x512 PNG both loaded.
Uniform pink rendered with mapRemoved=true and color #ff69b4.
No page errors or external requests in front/rear render.
Original, embedded, and pink bounds match within renderer precision.

visualVerdict.observation: Compared with the preserved nearest-filter experiment, explicit linear/trilinear sampling visibly smooths the large front spot and rear spot edges while retaining the original cap layout and stem coloration. Some 512-atlas edge softness/aliasing remains, so this is evidence of improvement rather than a fidelity acceptance claim.
visualVerdict.pinkComparator: The map-free uniform pink panel renders as solid pink in both front and rear views, confirming texture contribution is removed.

limitations: This remains an isolated prototype; runtime loader/material/export integration was not changed.
Visual evidence is human-reviewed; no pixel-difference or perceptual score was generated.
No resolution tuning loop was run. A future architecture decision may need a larger atlas or runtime texture preservation if 512px fidelity is insufficient.
